## Soft-fails / out-of-band

- `host port 5432` — occupied by an unrelated project (`gateway-api-db-1`). `.env.test`'s default `TEST_DATABASE_URL` points at `localhost:5432`, i.e. the foreign DB, so on this host the suite only works with `TEST_DATABASE_URL` exported (as the evaluator did). Not a contract violation; worth noting in the README.
- `stack pre-existing` — the compose stack was already up from the implementation step; the evaluator health-checked it rather than starting it, so no PIDs were recorded in `processes.lock`. Stack left running (restored to 2 workers, default image) after the run.
- `test gate wipes ephemeral DB` — `make test` runs a migration downgrade/upgrade round-trip against `TEST_DATABASE_URL`, which removed the `audit-seed` row; it was re-seeded before the Service items.
- `browser deps` — `libasound.so.2` missing on host; supplied from `apt-get download libasound2` under the run tmpdir (no system change).
- `temporary fixture copies` — CLI-GATES-03/04/05 copy fixtures into source paths as the contract requires; each copy was removed right after its command (`git status` clean).
- `E2E-BOOT-01 images` — the fresh-clone boot reused locally built `chatledger-*:local` images (warm cache, same commit), so build-time SHA resolution was not re-run in the clone.
